Specification: This module specifies a collection of functional tests for set operators by defining a trivial state machine with Init == TRUE and Next == TRUE, and expressing the actual tests as state predicates. It constructs several concrete sets and then checks equality, inequality, membership, subset relations, union, intersection, set difference, Cartesian product, powerset behavior, quantified properties, CHOOSE-based selection, and finiteness/cardinality properties. The spec is intended as a test suite for set semantics and related operators, including some commented TODO cases that document known tool issues, and it does not include temporal verification beyond the trivial Init/Next skeleton.
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE i \in Set1357:
        \A j \in Set1357: i <= j

CHOOSE T \in { SetEmpty, Set263, Set1357 }:
            6 \in T

CHOOSE T \in { SetEmpty, Set263, Set1357 }:
            3 \in T
